'''Netek''' was a cunning and ruthless [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who participated in a scheme with his [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] partner and [[Bulsar]] to swindle [[Malrik]]. During the chaos that unfolded, Netek played a critical role in ensuring the plan's success. When Malrik confronted him, accusing the group of theft and aiming his [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], Netek acted decisively. He killed Malrik in a swift and calculated move, demonstrating his readiness to eliminate threats without hesitation.<ref name="Fly Casual" />

==Behind the scenes==
Netek was first mentioned in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
